newsitem.title: USA: Aetna unit to buy financial planner.
newsitem.headline: Aetna unit to buy financial planner.

text.p: Aetna Inc said Wednesday its Aetna Retirement Services unit will buy Financial Network Investment Corp for an undisclosed amount of cash.

Financial Network Investment, a privately held broker-dealer firm based in Torrance, Calif., will become an affiliate of Aetna Retirement Services, Aetna said. It has $18 billion in client assets and 177 branch offices in 35 states.
The move will position Aetna as a leader in the financial planning industry, the company said. Aetna Retirement Services has two million customers and $34 billion in assets nationwide.

Miles Gordon will continue as Financial Network Investment's chief executive, and John Simmers will continue as chief operating officer, Aetna said. Aetna will appoint six of 11 members of Financial Network Investment's baord.
